description: Dollar volume by country or market: the total trading volume in US dollars of each of the 13 stock markets InfinityVolume covers (or one), for the latest session or the last 5 or 20 sessions, with the latest session versus normal, each market's share of global dollar volume and what the total covers. Market totals only: no prices and no company figures.

market.description: One market's key or name (e.g. US, Japan, Germany). Leave out for every market.

window.description: Sessions summed: 1d, 5d or 20d (or a number of sessions, a week or a month). Default 1d (the latest session).

name: infinity_market_totals
title: Market dollar volume totals
